'''Juin son of [[Lacel]] son of [[Laud]]''' is an [[Ogier]].

== Appearance ==
He has a narrow beard.

== Activities ==
He stops the fight between the [[Maidens of the Spear]] and the [[Shienar]] warriors from fighting each other while they are in his home of [[Stedding Tsofu|''Stedding'' Tsofu]]. He leads [[Rand al'Thor]] and his group to the [[Elder]]s. {{ref/book|2|35}}
